nodes.label: JWT Authentication (Bearer access token)
nodes.rationale: API supports JWT plus Django session auth; access token in body, refresh token in httpOnly cookie

nodes.label: Rate Limiting Zones (api/auth/perip)
nodes.rationale: api zone 30/min, auth zone 5/min, max 20 concurrent connections per IP

nodes.label: Authentication Endpoints (login, register, profile, verify-email, password reset, 2FA reset)
Email Enumeration Prevention (generic responses)
nodes.rationale: Resend-verification, password-reset and 2fa-reset return the same message regardless of whether the email exists

nodes.label: Refresh Token Rotation (httpOnly cookie, blacklist)
nodes.rationale: Old refresh token blacklisted on each refresh (one-time use)

nodes.label: X-Requested-With CSRF Header Check
nodes.rationale: Cookie-authenticated endpoints require X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest for CSRF protection

nodes.label: Users Endpoints (me, leaderboard, match-history, analytics, achievements)
GET /api/leaderboard/
nodes.rationale: Top 50 by rating then wins; excludes stockfish_ai users

nodes.label: Admin User Management (/api/users/)
nodes.rationale: Admins cannot modify themselves or other admins

nodes.label: API Key Management (/api/me/api-key/)
nodes.rationale: Plain-text key (bt_ prefix) shown only once at generation

nodes.label: POST /api/me/import/
nodes.rationale: Only safe fields (display_name, bio, friends) imported; read-only fields skipped; max 10 MB

nodes.label: User Blocking (block/unblock/blocked)
nodes.rationale: Blocking removes friendship and cancels pending friend requests; prevents DMs

nodes.label: Chat Moderation (delete message, mute, unmute)
nodes.rationale: Moderators cannot act on staff; mute can be global or room-scoped, 1-1440 minutes

nodes.label: Game Status Lifecycle (WAITING, IN_PROGRESS, FINISHED, CANCELLED)
Tournament Bracket Generation & Advancement
nodes.rationale: Start generates full bracket, auto-starts AI-vs-AI first-round matches; recording a winner triggers advancement

nodes.label: Goose Game Endpoints (/api/goose/)
nodes.rationale: 2-6 players, creator-only start/cancel, creator leaving cancels game

nodes.label: Suspicious Activity Detection (24h)
nodes.rationale: Flags 3+ failed logins, recent lockouts and password resets

nodes.label: Health Endpoints (/healthz/, /api/health/, /api/health/ready)
nodes.rationale: Used by Docker health checks; no authentication

hyperedges.label: Two-step login flow (credentials or OAuth -> tmp_token -> 2FA verify -> JWT)
OAuth callback conflict resolution (login_token, link_token, resolve_token)
